legend: A renowned abstract artist Sasha, drawing inspiration from nowhere, decided to paint a picture entitled "Special Olympics". He justly thought that, if the regular Olympic games have five rings, then the Special ones will do with exactly two rings just fine.

Let us remind you that a ring is a region located between two concentric circles with radii r and R (r < R). These radii are called internal and external, respectively. Concentric circles are circles with centers located at the same point.

Soon a white canvas, which can be considered as an infinite Cartesian plane, had two perfect rings, painted with solid black paint. As Sasha is very impulsive, the rings could have different radii and sizes, they intersect and overlap with each other in any way. We know only one thing for sure: the centers of the pair of rings are not the same.

When Sasha got tired and fell into a deep sleep, a girl called Ilona came into the room and wanted to cut a circle for the sake of good memories. To make the circle beautiful, she decided to cut along the contour.

We'll consider a contour to be a continuous closed line through which there is transition from one color to another (see notes for clarification). If the contour takes the form of a circle, then the result will be cutting out a circle, which Iona wants.
But the girl's inquisitive mathematical mind does not rest: how many ways are there to cut a circle out of the canvas?
input: Each line has four space-separated integers xi, yi, ri, Ri, that describe the i-th ring; xi and yi are coordinates of the ring's center, ri and Ri are the internal and external radii of the ring correspondingly ( - 100 ≤ xi, yi ≤ 100; 1 ≤ ri < Ri ≤ 100).
It is guaranteed that the centers of the rings do not coinside.
output: A single integer — the number of ways to cut out a circle from the canvas.
note: Figures for test samples are given below. The possible cuts are marked with red dotted line.

legend.ai: 著名的抽象艺术家 Sasha 不知从何处获得灵感，决定创作一幅名为“特殊奥林匹克运动会”的画作。他认为，既然普通的奥林匹克运动会有五个环，那么特殊奥林匹克运动会只需要恰好两个环也完全足够了。
提醒一下，圆环是位于两个同心圆之间的区域，这两个圆的半径分别为 r 和 R（r < R）。这两个半径分别称为内半径和外半径。同心圆是圆心位于同一点的圆。
很快，一块可以看作无限笛卡尔平面的白色画布上，出现了两个用纯黑颜料绘制的完美圆环。由于 Sasha 非常冲动，这两个圆环的半径和大小可能不同，它们可以以任意方式相交或重叠。我们唯一确定的是：这两个圆环的圆心不在同一点。
当 Sasha 感到疲倦并陷入沉睡时，一个名叫 Ilona 的女孩走进房间，想要切出一个圆形来留下美好的回忆。为了让这个圆形更加美观，她决定沿着轮廓进行切割。
我们将轮廓定义为一条连续的闭合曲线，曲线两侧的颜色会发生变化（详见注释）。如果轮廓呈圆形，那么切割的结果就是切出一个圆形，这正是 Iona 想要的。
但是，女孩充满好奇的数学头脑并未停歇：究竟有多少种方法可以从画布上切出一个圆形？

output.ai: 一个整数——从画布上剪出一个圆的方法数。

note.ai: 测试样例的图示如下。可能的剪法用红色虚线标出。

input.ai: 每行包含四个由空格分隔的整数 xi、yi、ri、Ri，用于描述第 i 个圆环；xi 和 yi 是圆环中心的坐标，ri 和 Ri 分别是圆环的内半径和外半径（-100 ≤ xi, yi ≤ 100；1 ≤ ri < Ri ≤ 100）。
保证两个圆环的中心不重合。
